detector: Run as a detector under Maat's ruling of 12 Oct 2026: exam bar not met (keep-vs-not 61% isiXhosa / 47% isiZulu); used because false keeps were 0 of 19 and 0 of 1, false cuts 4% and 3%. Flags are leads for Maat, not verdicts.

rows.en: The first breeze of the day has just arrived. Give it a round of applause.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci wokuqala wosuku usandul' ukufika. Wuqhwabele izandla.
rows.reason: Natural: 'umoya omncinci' for breeze and 'Wuqhwabele izandla' carries the applause with correct object concord.

rows.en: Lowveld summer: you don't sweat, you melt with dignity.
rows.draft: Ihlobo laseLowveld: awubili, unyibilika ngesidima.
rows.reason: 'awubili, unyibilika ngesidima' is a clean two-beat turn; isidima is the house word for dignity.

rows.en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
rows.draft: Amafu adlula kancinci. YiCawa; avumelekile.
rows.reason: Plain and natural; 'YiCawa; avumelekile' gives the Sunday permission turn.

rows.en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
rows.draft: Intaba izigqume intloko ngengubo. Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu.
rows.reason: The mountain pulling the blanket over its head reads naturally; 'Kulungile, nguLwesihlanu' lands the Friday excuse.

rows.en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.
rows.draft: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nesibhakabhaka.
rows.reason: Stiff: 'Akukho mpazamo namhlanje' says no mistakes happened rather than the day making none; a speaker would say 'Nditsho nesibhakabhaka' for 'Sky included'.
rows.rewrite: Usuku lwanamhlanje alukenzi mpazamo nanye ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nditsho nesibhakabhaka.

rows.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
rows.draft: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali.
rows.held: held after Maat fix: held: checker triage-high
rows.reason: 'Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali' says kicking, not pedalling; a speaker would say 'asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali'.
rows.rewrite: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali.

rows.en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
rows.draft: Inyanga ityelela phakathi kwamafu. Iyayiva ivumba lenyama ukusuka phaya phezulu.
rows.reason: The moon visiting between clouds and smelling the meat reads naturally; 'iyayiva ivumba lenyama' is right.

rows.en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.
rows.draft: Isiqwengana sokugqibela seenkuni sisigqibo, asiyonto nje ekhoyo.
rows.reason: A log is 'isikhuni', not 'isiqwengana seenkuni' (a piece of wood); 'asiyonto nje ekhoyo' loses the inventory idea, 'yokubalwa' (to be counted) keeps it.
rows.rewrite: Isikhuni sokugqibela sisigqibo, asiyonto nje yokubalwa.

rows.en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
rows.draft: Inyanga ingemva kwelifu, inja isestoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.
rows.reason: 'ingemva kwelifu' is wrong: behind a cloud is 'isemva kwelifu'; 'isestoep' reads better as 'ikwi-stoep'. The church-service turn lands.
rows.rewrite: Inyanga isemva kwelifu, inja ikwi-stoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.

rows.en: Bring your own ice. The friendship doesn't cover ice.
rows.draft: Yiza nomkhenkce wakho. Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce.
rows.reason: Clear and dry; 'Ubuhlobo abubandakanyi umkhenkce' is slightly formal but carries the joke.

rows.en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
rows.draft: Loo mafu adlula nje. Nditsho nombona uyazi ukuba akufuneki uvuye.
rows.reason: 'Nditsho nombona uyazi' is natural, with correct class 3 concords for umbona.

rows.en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.
rows.draft: Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku yenza zonke izitrato zibe ziindawo zokwenza ifilimu.
rows.reason: Long and stiff: 'Inkungu yentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku' stacks possessives, and the house form is 'izitalato', not 'izitrato'.
rows.rewrite: Ngentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku, inkungu yenza zonke izitalato zibe yiseti yefilimu.

rows.en: Prettiest moment of the day. Also the shortest. Run.
rows.draft: Lelona xesha lihle losuku. Kwaye lelona lifutshane. Baleka.
rows.reason: Three short beats, all natural; 'Baleka' lands the urgency.

rows.en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
rows.draft: Ngu-6 ngentsasa, kwaye ifriji sele iyeyona ndawo ithandwayo endlwini.
rows.reason: Natural; it mirrors the confirmed fridge line ('yeyona ndawo ... endlini') with the 6am turn.

rows.en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.
rows.draft: Ihlathi lithe cwaka namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.
rows.reason: 'Ihlathi' means forest, not bushveld, and 'lithe cwaka' drops the phone 'silent mode' joke; people code-switch both here.
rows.rewrite: IBushveld ikwi-silent mode namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.

rows.en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle bavumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.
rows.reason: Agreement: sky and sea joined take 'zivumelene', not the human 'bavumelene'; the rest reads well.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle zivumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.

rows.en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
rows.draft: Kuyabanda nyhani namhlanje. Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho.
rows.reason: 'Yingqele egqobhoza iijezi ezintathu ngathi azikho' is vivid and natural.

rows.en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.
rows.draft: Icala elinesithunzi lebala lilizwe lalo ngokwalo.
rows.reason: Shade is 'umthunzi' ('isithunzi' is shadow or dignity), the possessive order is awkward, and 'lilizwe lalo' (its own country) loses the climate; 'linemozulu yalo' keeps it.
rows.rewrite: Icala lebala elinomthunzi linemozulu yalo ngokwalo.

rows.en: Karoo sky: same flawless blue for the next 400 km. Guaranteed.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka olufanayo kwiikhilomitha ezingama-400 ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.
rows.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank
rows.reason: 'Isibhakabhaka ... luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka' says sky-blue sky and lacks the subject concord; 'flawless' is lost. A speaker would say 'siluhlaza, singenalifu nelinye'.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka saseKaroo: siluhlaza, singenalifu nelinye, kwii-400 km ezizayo. Kuqinisekisiwe.

rows.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
rows.draft: Isandla ekepusini, inyathelo ngenyathelo. Umoya omncinci uhamba naye.
rows.reason: 'inyathelo ngenyathelo' and 'uhamba naye' carry the pacing image naturally.

rows.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.
rows.draft: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci unamacebo awo angeCawa.
rows.reason: The hair arriving first and the breeze's Sunday plans read naturally and land.

rows.en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka senza umboniso. Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi.
rows.reason: Short and dry; 'Iintlanzi, njengesiqhelo, azenzi' turns neatly against the sky's show.

rows.en: Cape cold is wet cold. It moves into your bones and unpacks.
rows.draft: Ingqele yaseKapa yingqele emanzi. Ingena emathanjeni akho ize ihlale.
rows.reason: Natural; 'ingena emathanjeni akho' is how a speaker says it. 'ize ihlale' is flatter than 'unpacks' but reads warm.

rows.en: Rooibos in hand, blanket to the ears. Full kit.
rows.draft: IRooibos esandleni, ingubo ide ifike ezindlebeni. Sizixhobile.
rows.reason: Natural picture; 'Sizixhobile' (we're armed/kitted out) carries 'Full kit' with a dry turn.

rows.en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.
rows.draft: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele.
rows.reason: 'ingakhange icele' leaves 'cela' hanging with no object and drops 'even'; a speaker would say it came without even asking permission.
rows.rewrite: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele nemvume.

rows.en: The whole town just switched itself to whisper volume.
rows.draft: Idolophu yonke izitshintshele kwivolyum yokusebeza.
rows.reason: 'ivolyum yokusebeza' is a natural code-switch; the town-turned-down image lands.

rows.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
rows.draft: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zizithathela indawo.
rows.reason: 'zizithathela indawo' reads as the lights taking a place for themselves, not standing in for the stars; 'izibane ezincinci' (small lights) loses the fairy lights. 'ziyazibambela' says covering for them.
rows.rewrite: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane zokuhombisa ziyazibambela.

rows.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
rows.draft: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele ukuba sihlawulelwe irhafu, inyani.
rows.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank
rows.reason: 'sihlawulelwe irhafu' means someone pays tax on its behalf, not that it is taxed — needs 'sihlawuliswe irhafu'; 'inyani' tacked on is stiff where the app says 'Ngenene.'
rows.rewrite: Isiselo sokuqala emva kosuku lweedigri ezingama-35 bekufanele sihlawuliswe irhafu. Ngenene.

rows.en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.
rows.draft: Ndilibale ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ngobusuku. Bonke.
rows.reason: 'Ngobusuku. Bonke.' reassembles as 'ubusuku bonke' = the whole night, not every night; the habitual is also lost in the one-off past 'Ndilibale'.
rows.rewrite: Ndisoloko ndilibala ukuvula i-electric blanket kwangethuba. Qho. Ebusuku.

rows.en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
rows.draft: Iiflegi zisancokola. Izikhephe ziyigqibile iveki.
rows.reason: 'zisancokola' and 'ziyigqibile iveki' are natural and carry the two-beat turn.

rows.en: The weather made the plans. We just RSVP'd.
rows.draft: Imozulu yenze amacebo. Thina siphendule nje sathi siyeza.
rows.reason: Everyday isiXhosa; 'siphendule nje sathi siyeza' is a good native render of RSVP'd.

rows.en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.
rows.draft: IDolophu enoBubele ayizange icele ukuba yiDolophu enoMoya, kodwa ke.
rows.reason: 'IDolophu enoBubele' is a translated nickname a reader won't recognise as Gqeberha; people keep 'Friendly City' / 'Windy City' as loans and name the place.
rows.rewrite: IGqeberha, i-Friendly City, ayizange icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa ke.

rows.en: Even the impala are standing in the shade rethinking their choices.
rows.draft: Nditsho neempala zimi emthunzini ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo.
rows.reason: Natural; 'ziphinda zicinga ngezigqibo zazo' lands the rethinking-their-choices joke.

rows.en: The berg wind turned overnight. Cape Town, today you're basically Upington.
rows.draft: Umoya oshushu wasezintabeni utshintshe ebusuku. Kapa, namhlanje uphantse ube yi-Upington.
rows.reason: Plain descriptive phrase for berg wind is right; vocative 'Kapa' and 'uphantse ube yi-Upington' read naturally.

rows.en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
rows.draft: Induli ishukuma ngathi ngamaza. Iinkomo zigqibe ekubeni zingaboni nto.
rows.reason: Natural; the cattle choosing not to see anything keeps the dry turn.

rows.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sithe cwaka, nomgca uthe cwaka. UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum.
rows.reason: 'sithe cwaka' twice and personified 'UMvulo akakayifumani ivolyum' read naturally and keep the joke.

rows.en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
rows.draft: Izihlangu kwiikona zengubo. Umoya omncinci wamkelekile, isanti ayamkelekanga.
rows.reason: Natural and correct; 'wamkelekile / ayamkelekanga' gives the two-beat contrast.

rows.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.
rows.draft: Ilaphu letafile li-ayiniwe kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
rows.reason: 'li-ayiniwe' is a malformed passive of the loan 'ayina' (iron) — the form is 'li-ayinwe'; 'kwaye' is stiff here.
rows.rewrite: Ilaphu letafile li-ayinwe, lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.

rows.en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
rows.draft: Amafu ambalwa eze kubukela. Nawo akabaleki.
rows.reason: 'eze kubukela' is a participial/subjunctive form, not a main-clause past; a speaker would say 'afike ezokubukela'.
rows.rewrite: Amafu ambalwa afike ezokubukela. Nawo akabaleki.

rows.en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
rows.draft: Inyanga isoloko iphuma ijonga igaraji. Akukho nto yenzekayo.
rows.reason: 'igaraji' is what people call the petrol station; the moon checking in reads natural, if a touch flat without 'still'.

rows.en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sayinwa ngumkhenkce.
rows.reason: 'sayinwa' reads as 'it was signed' (sayina = sign), not ironed; 'ice-pressed' does not carry — say freshly washed, clean and ice-cold.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sicocekile, sibanda njengomkhenkce.

rows.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.
rows.draft: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owa uvela esibhakabhakeni.
rows.reason: 'Ngumvuzo' (wage) falling from the sky lands; 'efama' and the structure are natural.

rows.en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
rows.draft: Umpompo womoya awukholelwa kwixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini. Nenja ayikholelwa.
rows.reason: 'ixesha lokuphuma emsebenzini' is the everyday way to say knock-off time; 'Nenja ayikholelwa' gives the dry second beat.

rows.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
rows.draft: Iflegi yekona ibonisa kanye apho ibhola iza kutyekela khona.
rows.reason: Understood and natural; the wind pushing the ball comes through even though 'conversions' is dropped.

rows.en: Midlands mist: the countryside's privacy setting.
rows.draft: Inkungu yaseMidlands: indlela amaphandle azifihla ngayo.
rows.reason: Natural: 'the way the countryside hides itself' carries the privacy idea plainly; the tech wink of 'privacy setting' is softened but the warm observation stands.

rows.en: Perfect weather to bump into someone you've 'been meaning to call'.
rows.draft: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokudibana nomntu 'obusoloko uceba ukumtsalela umnxeba'.
rows.reason: Reads naturally; 'ukumtsalela umnxeba' is the everyday way to say phone someone. 'Ukudibana' means meet rather than physically bump, so the fog pun is softer, but the jab at the reader lands.

rows.en: Highveld mornings: freezing, gorgeous, zero apologies.
rows.draft: Iintsasa zaseHighveld: kubanda kakhulu, kuhle, akukho kuxolisa.
rows.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank
rows.reason: Three-beat list works in isiXhosa; 'akukho kuxolisa' has the same punch as the confirmed 'Akukho zaba'.

rows.en: Even the dog checked the forecast and went straight back to bed.
rows.draft: Nditsho nenja ijonge imozulu yaza yabuyela ebhedini.
rows.reason: Natural, with the 'Nditsho nenja' opening the natives use; the dog going back to bed lands.

rows.en: The sun clocked in before your alarm even tried.
rows.draft: Ilanga liqale umsebenzi phambi kokuba i-alamu yakho izame.
rows.reason: Sun starting work before the alarm reads naturally; correct subjunctive after 'phambi kokuba'.

rows.en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
rows.draft: Inyanga ikhanya kancinci ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko asinako oko.
rows.reason: Correct but flat: 'ikhanya kancinci' drops the dimmer image and 'asinako oko' turns the punchline vague; urban speakers would keep the loan words, as the natives kept 'ultra mode' and 'vibe'.
rows.rewrite: Inyanga ikwi-dimmer ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko sona asinayo loo setting.

rows.en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci wenza wonke umsebenzi. Ikhayithi ifumana lonke udumo.
rows.reason: Clean two-beat turn; 'udumo' carries 'credit' well and 'umoya omncinci' is understood as a breeze.

rows.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
rows.draft: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zizathu. UMvulo uphantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.
rows.reason: 'izizathu' means reasons, not excuses; the confirmed lines say 'akukho zaba'. 'NguMvulo phantsi' reads more naturally than 'UMvulo uphantsi'.
rows.rewrite: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zaba. NguMvulo phantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.

rows.en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.
rows.draft: Ukubona: akukho. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.
rows.reason: 'Ukubona: akukho' (seeing: there is none) is stiff; visibility is 'ukubonakala', and people just say 'zero' as in the confirmed 'iku zero'.
rows.rewrite: Ukubonakala: zero. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.

rows.en: The sea has vanished but the tannies are here. Priorities.
rows.draft: Ulwandle lunyamalele kodwa oomakazi bakhona. Izinto eziphambili.
rows.reason: 'Oomakazi' works for the tannies, and 'sea vanished but the aunties are here' lands; 'Izinto eziphambili' is a bit literal but understood.

rows.en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.
rows.draft: Umphefumlo omnye womoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke liyimbongi.
rows.reason: 'Umphefumlo omnye' reads as 'one soul', not one breath; a speaker would use the verb 'uphefumla'. 'Imbongi' is a great fit for poet.
rows.rewrite: Uphefumla kanye umoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke libe yimbongi.

rows.en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.
rows.draft: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona.
rows.reason: 'Inenwele ekuphela kwazo ezenzelwe wona' is stiff and translated; 'inwele' is a single human hair, and the hairstyle joke is lost.
rows.rewrite: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyo yodwa ene-hairstyle eyenzelwe wona.

rows.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.
rows.draft: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Thina asinakutsho njalo.
rows.reason: Natural, and the turn 'Thina asinakutsho njalo' lands as dry self-mockery.

rows.en: Gqeberha, we know. We know.
rows.draft: Gqeberha, siyazi. Siyazi.
rows.reason: Short and natural; 'siyazi. Siyazi.' carries the knowing sympathy exactly.

rows.en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.
rows.draft: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Inyani, liyakufanele.
rows.reason: 'liyakufanele' means 'it suits you', not 'it deserves it' ('liyifanele', as in the confirmed 'Uyifanele'); 'honestly' is 'Ngenene' in the confirmed lines.
rows.rewrite: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Ngenene, liyifanele.

rows.en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
rows.draft: Amafu okutshona kwelanga, amanzi okunkcenkceshela iidiliya. Ifama izilungiselela eyayo imvula.
rows.reason: Understandable and correct; the farm making its own rain comes through, though the sunset/sprinkler pairing is a little literal.

rows.en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.
rows.draft: Yithi inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise ibraai yangoMgqibelo.
rows.reason: 'Yithi inyani' is unusual; a speaker says 'Thetha inyani' for 'be honest'. The rest is natural.
rows.rewrite: Thetha inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise i-braai yangoMgqibelo.

rows.en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.
rows.draft: Onke amacebo ngoku afuduselwe 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.
rows.reason: 'afuduselwe' means relocated (moving house), not postponed ('ahlehliselwe'); 'officially' dropped. 'Hayi bo' is a good fit for 'Shame'.
rows.rewrite: Onke amacebo ahlehliselwe ngokusemthethweni 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.

rows.en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
rows.draft: Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka. Isibhakabhaka simisele umzekelo.
rows.reason: 'Nditsho ne-hadeda ithe cwaka' is natural; the sky setting the example lands.

rows.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
rows.draft: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka bangwevu ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.
rows.reason: 'bangwevu' uses the human class-2 concord and 'ngwevu' is grey hair; sea and sky take 'zi-' and the colour is 'mpunga' (as in the confirmed 'Mhlawumbi mpunga').
rows.rewrite: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka zimpunga ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.

rows.en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
rows.draft: Iiglasi zelanga ziyanxitywa, ziyakhululwa, ziyanxitywa. Emva kwemini ngoLwesihlanu kukuzilolonga.
rows.reason: The on-off-on rhythm survives; 'kukuzilolonga' carries the workout joke even without 'interval'.

rows.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
rows.draft: Ulwandle luziidigri ezili-12. Ngentsimbi yeshumi luza kuziva ngathi yispa.
rows.reason: Natural, with 'ngentsimbi yeshumi' as the time word and the 'kuziva ngathi' shape natives kept; the irony comes through, if a little flat.

rows.en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
rows.draft: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akuze kubande ngoku bayavuma.
rows.reason: bayavuma has nothing to admit: a speaker says what they admit (bayavuma ukuba kuyabanda, as in the confirmed Capetonians line); akusoze is the everyday 'never', and ngoku sits awkwardly mid-clause.
rows.rewrite: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akusoze kubande sebeyavuma ukuba kuyabanda.

rows.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
rows.draft: Ilanga alizukuza kujonga ukukhazimla namhlanje. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.
rows.reason: alizukuza kujonga doubles the future marker (a speaker says aliyi kujonga / alizokujonga), and ukukhazimla alone loses that it is the car's shine being inspected.
rows.rewrite: Namhlanje ilanga aliyi kujonga ukukhazimla kwemoto. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.

rows.en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.
rows.draft: Ungwevu wempelaveki: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto konke konke.
rows.reason: ungwevu as a noun for 'greyness' is not how people say grey (natives used mpunga), and konke konke reads isiZulu; isiXhosa says kwaphela, as in the confirmed 'ukungenzi nto kwaphela'.
rows.rewrite: Impelaveki empunga: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto kwaphela.

rows.en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
rows.draft: Ithafa lonke ngathi umbala uthotyiwe. Iigusha zibalwa ngendlela efanayo noko.
rows.reason: umbala uthotyiwe is a calque of 'turned down' (thoba = lower/humble), and zibalwa ngendlela efanayo says the sheep are counted the same way, not that the count is unchanged.
rows.rewrite: Ithafa lonke libonakala ngathi umbala wehlisiwe. Inani leegusha alitshintshi noko.

rows.en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.
rows.draft: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku nengqele enkulu.
rows.reason: bubusuku nengqele enkulu is clumsy (night 'and big cold') and drops the North Pole image that carries the joke; the place name can stay as a code-switch.
rows.rewrite: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku, kubande ngathi kuseNorth Pole.

rows.en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.
rows.draft: Ilaphu letafile lentaba lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.
rows.reason: lingaphezulu ngesiqingatha means 'more by half / above by a half', not that the tablecloth only half covers the mountain; the Monday half fits.
rows.rewrite: Ilaphu letafile lentaba ligqume isiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.

rows.en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.
rows.draft: Ifama isekhona. Sikholelwa nje kwilizwi lomnye nomnye.
rows.reason: kwilizwi lomnye nomnye is a word-for-word 'each other's word' and sounds translated; a speaker would say they just trust what they tell each other.
rows.rewrite: Ifama isekhona. Sithembele nje kwinto esixelelana yona.

rows.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
rows.draft: Mfusa emhlabeni, mhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamkelwe.
rows.reason: Bare colour stems mfusa / mhlophe read like the natives' 'Mhlawumbi mpunga'; kaLwesihlanu and yamkelwe give the dry approval turn.

rows.en: It's a beautiful day to stay indoors.
rows.draft: Lusuku oluhle lokuhlala ngaphakathi.
rows.reason: Same shape as the confirmed 'Lusuku oluhle lokuhamba'; natural, and the dissonance lands.

rows.en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
rows.draft: Amafu abe pinki kanye ngexesha lokupakisha. Akukho mntu upakishileyo.
rows.reason: pinki and pakisha are the natural code-switch; the second beat 'Akukho mntu upakishileyo' turns cleanly.

rows.en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Hayi.
rows.reason: sizigqumile and iingubo zakho ziyakulinda are good; Hayi answers 'Coincidence?' flatly where the English says 'Never' — nakanye carries it.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Nakanye.

rows.en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
rows.draft: Uthuli lukhazimla ngathi yigolide ekukhanyeni kokutshona kwelanga. Umdlalo uyaqhubeka.
rows.reason: Natural and clear — dust shining like gold at sundown, the match carries on; the 'going for gold' pun is softened but the warm observation reads.

rows.en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
rows.draft: Izilwanyana zasendle azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azikhalazi. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
rows.reason: izilwanyana zasendle flattens the blesbok into 'wild animals' and loses the SA detail — keep the loan; 'file no complaints' reads better with the confirmed 'fake isikhalazo' shape.
rows.rewrite: Iiblesbok azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azifaki zikhalazo. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.

rows.en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: ngwevu, icocekile, ayixeli nto.
rows.reason: ayixeli nto agrees with the suit, not the sky; the English has the sky giving nothing away — asixeli nto, and a relative for the suit's colour.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: empunga, ecocekileyo, kwaye asixeli nto.

rows.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayidingi mvume yelanga.
rows.reason: ayidingi reads isiZulu for 'need'; an isiXhosa speaker says ayifuni. The rest (isikolo siphumile, iijezi zinxitywe) is natural.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayifuni mvume yelanga.

rows.en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
rows.draft: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba asiyiyo imozulu. Umlilo uhlala uvutha.
rows.reason: asiyiyo imozulu says 'it is not the weather' and does not agree with ilifu; 'weather event' is isiganeko semozulu, in the confirmed 'ayisosiphelo sehlabathi' shape.
rows.rewrite: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba ayisosiganeko semozulu. Umlilo usavutha.

rows.en: The front left. The cold just moved in permanently.
rows.draft: Ifronti ihambile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.
rows.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank
rows.reason: Ifronti is a forced loan a reader will not follow; say the rain/bad weather passed. 'Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina' is good and keeps the joke.
rows.rewrite: Imvula idlulile. Ingqele yona ifudukele apha ngokusisigxina.

rows.en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.
rows.draft: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ubusuku bufikile noko.
rows.reason: ngokuhlwanje is not the everyday 'tonight' (ngokuhlwa namhlanje / namhlanje), and ubusuku is night where the English says the evening showed up.
rows.rewrite: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka namhlanje. Kodwa ukuhlwa kufikile noko.

rows.en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
rows.draft: Amafu emva kwemini yonke, akukho thontsi. Umbhobho wamanzi ubuyele emsebenzini.
rows.reason: Fragment mirrors the English; akukho thontsi and the hose 'back at work' (ubuyele emsebenzini) land naturally.

rows.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
rows.draft: Isibhakabhaka sisuke kungwevu olukhanyayo saya kungwevu olumnyama. Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo.
rows.reason: ungwevu olukhanyayo / olumnyama is laboured, and Yayiyiyo yonke imiboniso leyo says 'that was all the shows' (plural); a speaker says ngumboniso wonke lowo.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka besingwevu kancinci, ngoku singwevu kakhulu. Ngumboniso wonke lowo.

rows.en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci usashushu ngeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
rows.reason: usashushu says the breeze is still hot; warm is usafudumele. The sea leaving the heater on all night is good.
rows.rewrite: Umoya usafudumele nangeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.

rows.en: The sun clocked out without saying bye. Rude, but relatable.
rows.draft: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga. Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda.
rows.reason: liphume emsebenzini lingavalelisanga is a natural 'clocked out without saying bye'; Akukho mbeko, kodwa siyaqonda keeps the two-beat turn.

rows.en: We don't talk about today. Today is over. We're proud of us.
rows.draft: Asithethi nganamhlanje. Namhlanje kuphelile. Siyazingca.
rows.reason: Three short plain beats; 'Siyazingca' carries the self-pride turn warmly.

rows.en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
rows.draft: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwabadlali bamaza. Ithi: hambani.
rows.reason: 'abadlali bamaza' is a translated coinage for surfers (people just say ii-surfer), and 'hambani' reads as 'go away' rather than 'get in the water'.
rows.rewrite: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwee-surfer. Ithi: ngenani emanzini.

rows.en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.
rows.draft: Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.
rows.reason: 'Owokugqibela ukudlula uvala' is stiff and states a fact; the house rule reads naturally as 'Ogqibela ukudlula makavale'.
rows.rewrite: Ogqibela ukudlula makavale isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.

rows.en: When the weather behaves this well, so do we. Roughly.
rows.draft: Xa imozulu iziphethe kakuhle kangaka, nathi siyaziphatha. Phantse.
rows.reason: Natural reflexive play (iziphethe / siyaziphatha) and 'Phantse' lands the dry 'Roughly'.

rows.en: Sun, then cloud, then sun. Even the monkeys can't plan around that.
rows.draft: Ilanga, emva koko ilifu, emva koko ilanga. Nditsho neenkawu azikwazi ukwenza icebo.
rows.reason: The repeated 'emva koko' gives the back-and-forth rhythm; 'Nditsho neenkawu' is the natives' own construction.

rows.en: Jeffreys Bay: where the wind warms up before its Cape Town shift.
rows.draft: IJeffreys Bay: apho umoya uzilolonga khona phambi komsebenzi wawo eKapa.
rows.reason: 'uzilolonga' (practising) is a good image for warming up; the wind-as-worker joke carries.

rows.en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
rows.draft: Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Iinkomo zamkela oko.
rows.reason: 'Isibane seshedi kukutshona kwelanga' is a word-for-word copula, and 'zamkela oko' drops the downgrade so the turn goes flat.
rows.rewrite: Ngokuhlwanje isibane seshedi sithatha indawo yelanga elitshonayo. Iinkomo ziyavuma, nangona kungafani.

rows.en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.
rows.draft: Isekude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amahlanu, kodwa istoep sele sigcwele.
rows.reason: 'Isekude' has no subject a reader can find (what is far away?), and the spelled-out number is stiff where people say 50 km.
rows.rewrite: Isaqhwithi sisekude nge-50 km, kodwa i-stoep sele igcwele.

rows.en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.
rows.draft: Imozulu entle kangaka yeyokubolekwa. Umoya wasempuma-mzantsi ugcina iirisithi.
rows.reason: 'wasempuma-mzantsi' is back to front; the natives write the Southeaster as 'Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma'. 'yeyokubolekwa' is a bit stiff next to 'ibolekiwe nje'.
rows.rewrite: Imozulu entle kangaka ibolekiwe nje. Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma ugcina iirisithi.

rows.en: A day so good even rush hour felt optional.
rows.draft: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba nditsho nexesha lezithuthi ezininzi beliziva ngathi ngumba wokuzikhethela.
rows.held: not applied: the English line was cut from the bank
rows.reason: Long and translated: 'ixesha lezithuthi ezininzi' is a clumsy gloss of rush hour, and 'beliziva' makes the time itself feel things.
rows.rewrite: Usuku oluhle kangangokuba ne-rush hour ibingathi ayinyanzelekanga.

rows.en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
rows.draft: Isibane sokhuseleko sikhanyise kwangethuba. Ilanga alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle.
rows.reason: 'kwangethuba' and 'alizange liqale umsebenzi kakuhle' are natural; the sun as a worker who never clocked in lands.

rows.en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
rows.draft: Ilifu phezu kwentaba, ipotjie phantsi kwelapa. Zombini zisafuna enye iyure.
rows.reason: Clean parallel and 'Zombini zisafuna enye iyure' gives the turn; potjie and lapa stay as loans people use.

rows.en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.
rows.draft: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi konke. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.
rows.reason: 'ungahambi konke' is wrong: 'konke' means 'all'; 'not at all' is 'kwaphela'.
rows.rewrite: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi kwaphela. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.

rows.en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
rows.draft: Isiqingatha senyanga, isiqingatha selifu, umgqomo ugcwele. NgoLwesibini ebusuku, njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe.
rows.reason: Half/half/full list reads naturally with 'umgqomo ugcwele'; 'njengoko kwakuthenjisiwe' carries 'as advertised'.

rows.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
rows.draft: Umsi ufike eyadini yabamelwane. Ibraai yangoMgqibelo ngoku yeyoluntu lonke.
rows.reason: 'eyadini' and 'yeyoluntu lonke' are everyday and the community-braai turn lands; weekend braai is correct.

rows.en: The Karoo is opening its roof for the night. Dress warm for the show.
rows.draft: IKaroo ivula uphahla lwayo ebusuku. Nxiba iimpahla ezifudumeleyo kumboniso.
rows.reason: The roof-opening image survives intact and the instruction is plain and warm.

rows.en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.
rows.draft: Iindaba ezintsha: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.
rows.reason: 'Iindaba ezintsha' is just 'new news'; the breaking-news register that makes the joke is 'Iindaba ezishushu'.
rows.rewrite: Iindaba ezishushu: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.

rows.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.
rows.draft: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza koma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.
rows.reason: Natural, and 'ngolo landelelwano' keeps the deadpan 'in that order' turn.

rows.en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwindawo yeziqhamo namhlanje. Ipholisa simahla, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.
rows.reason: Agreement slip: 'Ipholisa' does not agree with umoya (u-); and the air-con joke is lost where people simply say i-aircon.
rows.rewrite: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwisitali seziqhamo namhlanje. I-aircon ifakiwe, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.

rows.en: Padstal coffee is functioning as central heating today.
rows.draft: Ikofu yepadstal isebenza njengesifudumezi namhlanje.
rows.reason: Short and natural; padstal coffee as the heater is a warm, clear image.

rows.en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.
rows.draft: UGqirha uhamba ejonga kusasa. Akufuneki kubhukisha, ngelishwa.
rows.reason: 'UGqirha' alone reads as a real doctor, not the wind; the natives keep the name 'I-Cape Doctor'. 'uhamba ejonga' is a loose gloss of rounds.
rows.rewrite: I-Cape Doctor ijikeleza kusasa. Akufuneki ubhukishe, ngelishwa.

rows.en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
rows.draft: Amafu ahlale kade ngenxa yombala kuphela. UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko.
rows.reason: Reads naturally; 'UMvulo ebetyala wonke umntu oko' uses the natives' own 'ityala' for owing.

rows.en: Cloud shadows crossing the outfield at a steady walk. Nobody's appealing.
rows.draft: Izithunzi zamafu ziwela ibala zihamba kancinci. Akukho mntu ukhalazayo.
rows.reason: Natural and clear; 'akukho mntu ukhalazayo' reads easily, though the cricket 'appeal' pun softens into plain 'nobody's complaining'.

rows.en: Every window switching on is someone deciding: that's enough for today.
rows.draft: Yonke ifestile ekhanyayo ngumntu ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje.
rows.reason: Reads like a speaker wrote it; 'ogqibe kwelokuba: kwanele namhlanje' carries the warm evening observation.

rows.en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.
rows.draft: Ungwevu kusasa. Mayihlale nje kancinci, njengeti.
rows.reason: 'Ungwevu kusasa' has no clear subject (reads like a grey-haired person), and 'mayihlale' points at nothing; the Earl Grey pun does not carry, so name the sky.
rows.rewrite: Isibhakabhaka singwevu kusasa. Njengeti, siyeke nje sihlale kancinci.

rows.en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
rows.draft: Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma. UMvulo uqala kancinci.
rows.reason: 'Ilanga liyangena, liyaphuma' is crisp and natural; 'uMvulo uqala kancinci' lands the soft launch.

rows.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci uthutha i-jacaranda iye kwesinye isitrato, intyatyambo ngentyatyambo. Istoep siyavuma.
rows.reason: 'uthutha i-jacaranda' says the wind carries the whole tree, not its flowers; 'isitrato' should be the usual 'isitalato'; the stoep reads better as 'I-stoep iyavuma'.
rows.rewrite: Umoya omncinci uthutha iintyatyambo ze-jacaranda uziyisa kwesinye isitalato, nganye nganye. I-stoep iyavuma.

rows.en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.
rows.draft: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Yintshayelelo leyo.
rows.reason: First sentence is natural; 'intshayelelo' (preface) loses the film-trailer joke, and people simply say 'trailer'.
rows.rewrite: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Leyo yi-trailer.

rows.en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
rows.draft: Amafu alinike ilanga ikhefu ngoLwesibini. Akukho mntu uxelele ubumanzi bomoya.
rows.reason: Sun given a day off by the clouds reads naturally; 'ubumanzi bomoya' is a plain, clear way to say humidity.

rows.en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
rows.draft: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Yile ndlela uMvulo ozolileyo ukhangeleka ngayo apha.
rows.reason: Second sentence is long and translated ('Yile ndlela ... ukhangeleka ngayo apha') and drops the deck; a speaker would say it shorter.
rows.rewrite: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Kwi-deck, nguMvulo ozolileyo lo.

rows.en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.
rows.draft: Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga asiyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Lichiza.
rows.reason: 'Isiselo sokutshona kwelanga' is a stiff calque; speakers say 'ii-sundowners', the way natives kept 'braai'.
rows.rewrite: Ii-sundowners aziyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Ngamayeza.

rows.en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.
rows.draft: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, inyani, kubanda ngakumbi.
rows.reason: 'inyani' on its own does not work as 'honestly'; the app's word is 'ngenene'.
rows.rewrite: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, ngenene, kubanda ngakumbi.

rows.en: Let's call it atmosphere and go inside.
rows.draft: Masithi yimeko entle, singene ngaphakathi.
rows.held: held: a safety line — needs the safety rule record (Claude + Sol) first
rows.reason: Natural; 'masithi yimeko entle' works as the same polite euphemism before retreating indoors.

rows.en: Wet tar at sunrise. That's not a smell, that's heritage.
rows.draft: ITar emanzi ekuphumeni kwelanga. Asilovumba elo, lilifa.
rows.reason: 'Asilovumba elo, lilifa' is a clean turn; the tar loan is the natural word.

rows.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
rows.draft: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nesithunzi. Ihlala khona.
rows.reason: Shade is 'umthunzi' ('isithunzi' is a shadow); 'Ihlala khona' reads 'it lives there' rather than 'it won't budge'.
rows.rewrite: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ayisuki apho.

rows.en: Out here even the sun refuses to rush.
rows.draft: Apha nditsho nelanga liyala ukungxama.
rows.reason: Short and natural; 'nditsho nelanga liyala ukungxama' is how a speaker would say it.

rows.en: Gqeberha doesn't sleep, it just holds on.
rows.draft: IGqeberha ayilali, ibambelela nje.
rows.reason: 'ayilali, ibambelela nje' is natural and keeps the windy-city wink.

rows.en: Grey is also a colour, says my ma. Today I believe her.
rows.draft: Ungwevu nawo ngumbala, utsho umama. Namhlanje ndiyamkholelwa.
rows.reason: Warm and natural, quoting umama; the grey-day turn survives.

rows.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
rows.draft: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
rows.reason: 'Usompempe' is the football referee, a cricket umpire is just 'umpire'; 'afinyeze amehlo' for squinting is not a sure phrase, so say it plainly.
rows.rewrite: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. I-umpire ayizange ibe nelanga emehlweni.

rows.en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
rows.draft: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajiwuzela. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.
rows.reason: 'ziyajiwuzela' is not a word I can confirm; swaying lights are 'ziyajinga'. The rest reads well.
rows.rewrite: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajinga. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.

rows.en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
rows.draft: Amagqabi asoloko ekhanyisa isibane sokhuseleko. Inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo.
rows.reason: Natural; 'inja ayisaphakami ngenxa yawo' gives the dog its dry dignity.

rows.en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
rows.draft: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uzibonakalisa nje kumntwana.
rows.reason: 'uzibonakalisa' means 'shows itself / appears', not 'shows off'; showing off is 'uyaziqhayisa'.
rows.rewrite: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uziqhayisa nje kumntwana.

rows.en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.
rows.draft: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungalimbi. Kugqibelele.
rows.reason: 'ngokwaneleyo ukuba' twice is a stiff calque, and the 'li' object never names the snow, so a reader cannot tell what is being admired or dug.
rows.rewrite: Ikhephu likufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kodwa likude kangangokuba akuyi kulisusa ngefosholo. Kugqibelele.

rows.en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.
rows.draft: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linuka kamnandi.
rows.reason: 'linuka' in isiXhosa leans to 'stinks', so 'linuka kamnandi' jars; a speaker says 'linevumba elimnandi'.
rows.rewrite: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linevumba elimnandi.

rows.en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
rows.draft: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, kunye nebhalkoni.
rows.reason: 'liphume emsebenzini' (knocked off) is a good idiom, but 'kunye nebhalkoni' tacked on the end reads translated; a speaker would give the balcony its own verb.
rows.rewrite: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, nebhalkoni isakhanya.

rows.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
rows.draft: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawangawangisa nje.
rows.reason: Natural and clear; 'iyawangawangisa nje' carries the grass waving along, though 'waving it on' loses a little of its cheer.

rows.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
rows.draft: Umntu uyilibele impahla. Umoya omncinci awuyilibalanga, kwaye wenza umsebenzi omhle.
rows.reason: Two beats with a turn; the breeze not forgetting the washing reads warm and natural.

rows.en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
rows.draft: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda.
rows.reason: 'Ibhalkoni ivuya ukulinda' is stiff (literal 'is happy to wait'); a speaker would say it has no problem waiting.
rows.rewrite: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ayinangxaki yokulinda.

rows.en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.
rows.draft: Uphefumla ngathi yinamba enomlilo, umbono ngathi liphupha.
rows.reason: 'inamba enomlilo' pictures a fire-snake, not a dragon's misty breath, and 'umbono' leans to opinion/vision; 'imbonakalo' is the view.
rows.rewrite: Uphefumla umsi ngathi yidragon, kodwa imbonakalo intle ngathi liphupha.

rows.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
rows.draft: Umoya omncinci uthwala umsi usiwa ezantsi kwesitrato. Isitrato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.
rows.reason: 'umsi usiwa' is the passive (being taken) where it should be 'uwusa' (taking it); 'isitrato' is spelt 'isitalato' in the app's confirmed lines.
rows.rewrite: Umoya uthwala umsi uwusa ezantsi kwesitalato. Isitalato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.

rows.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
rows.draft: Impahla iza koma phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.
rows.reason: Natural school-day line; 'uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba' gives the breeze the early shift cleanly.

rows.en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.
rows.draft: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iimpahla ezine nomoya omhle.
rows.reason: 'lolo hlobo lugqobhoza' needs the relative ('luhlobo olugqobhoza'), and 'nomoya omhle' reads as 'a nice wind' in a weather line, not a good mood.
rows.rewrite: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: luhlobo olugqobhoza iimpahla ezine ozinxibileyo, nemood yakho emnandi.

rows.en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
rows.draft: Isithunzi sihamba imigca ngemigca. Siyahlola.
rows.reason: Row by row is 'umgca ngomgca'; the plural 'imigca ngemigca' sounds off. 'Siyahlola' lands well.
rows.rewrite: Isithunzi sihamba umgca ngomgca. Siyahlola.

rows.en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.
rows.draft: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli konke konke.
rows.reason: 'konke konke' for 'at all' reads isiZulu-flavoured; isiXhosa says 'nakancinci' or 'tu'.
rows.rewrite: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli nakancinci.

rows.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.
rows.draft: Ababaleki bango-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.
rows.reason: 'Ababaleki' commonly reads as refugees/fugitives; say the people who run at 5:30.
rows.rewrite: Abantu ababaleka ngo-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.

rows.en: Joburg rain keeps a diary: 2pm sharp, maximum drama, no apologies.
rows.draft: Imvula yaseJoburg inedayari: ngo-2 emva kwemini kanye, idrama eninzi, akukho kuxolisa.
rows.reason: Code-switched 'inedayari' and 'idrama eninzi' sound like urban isiXhosa; the list rhythm keeps the joke.

rows.en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.
rows.draft: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ibhityileyo.
rows.reason: Relative concord slip: 'ibhatyi ibhityileyo' should be 'ebhityileyo' (thin jacket); otherwise the triplet works.
rows.rewrite: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ebhityileyo.

rows.en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.
rows.draft: Kumanqanaba amadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisipho sasimahla.
rows.reason: 'Kumanqanaba amadama!' does not read as a toast, and 'sisipho sasimahla' (free gift) loses the round-on-the-house drink.
rows.rewrite: Cheers kumadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisiselo sasimahla.

rows.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
rows.draft: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.
rows.reason: Long and stiff; 'ngokuhlwanje' is unsure, and the number reads easier as 'ezingama-30'.
rows.rewrite: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingama-30, kwaye ebusuku namhlanje bakubona kancinci ngakumbi.

rows.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
rows.draft: Impahla bekufanele ingene kwiiyure ezidlulileyo. Umoya omncinci uvote ukuba ihlale.
rows.reason: Washing does not come in by itself: 'ingeniswe' (be brought in); 'kwiiyure ezidlulileyo' is stiff where a speaker says 'kudala'; 'uvotele ... ihlale phandle' finishes the turn.
rows.rewrite: Impahla bekufanele ingeniswe kudala. Umoya uvotele ukuba ihlale phandle.

rows.en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.
rows.draft: Iinkomo zisekhaya phambi kokuba umbala uphele. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.
rows.reason: 'phambi kokuba umbala uphele' (before the colour ends) is opaque; 'phambi kokuba kuhlwe' is how a speaker says it. 'ICawa iphela ngexesha' is a lovely Sunday/church double.
rows.rewrite: Iinkomo sele zisekhaya phambi kokuba kuhlwe. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.

rows.en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.
rows.draft: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka ngokuqinisekileyo iceba into.
rows.reason: 'ngokuqinisekileyo' is bookish mid-sentence; a speaker would say 'kucacile ukuba'. 'iceba into' is right.
rows.rewrite: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka — kucacile ukuba iceba into.

rows.en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.
rows.draft: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa ngumkhenkce kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.
rows.reason: 'ukubanjwa ngumkhenkce' (caught by ice) is literal; 'ukubanjwa yingqele' is the natural way to say frostbite.
rows.rewrite: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa yingqele kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.

rows.en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
rows.draft: Amagqabi eentyatyambo ze-jacaranda nawo akhwele ibhasi. Umoya omncinci uwathengele amatikiti.
rows.reason: Petals riding the bus with tickets the breeze bought reads naturally and keeps the whimsy.

rows.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
rows.draft: Isanti iwela indlela ukhozo ngokhozo. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.
rows.reason: 'ukhozo ngokhozo' is a natural grain-by-grain image; calm second beat lands.

rows.en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
rows.draft: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya omncinci ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nootitshala.
rows.reason: The tag 'Nootitshala.' alone is abrupt; 'Nditsho nootitshala' is the natural 'teachers included'.
rows.rewrite: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nditsho nootitshala.
